create_distillation_loss: create a DistillationLoss module with a base criterion, teacher model, distillation type, alpha, and tau parameters
compute_soft_distillation_loss: compute a soft knowledge distillation loss using KL divergence between student and teacher softmax outputs scaled by temperature
compute_hard_distillation_loss: compute a hard knowledge distillation loss using cross entropy between student outputs and teacher argmax predictions
compute_combined_loss: compute a combined loss that blends the base criterion loss with the distillation loss weighted by alpha
run_distillation_forward: run the DistillationLoss forward pass with inputs, student outputs, and labels to get the total loss
